proposedProfile.meaning_type: Abstract rejection: refusing to accept something as true, here expressed aloud.
proposedProfile.connotation: Can suggest resistance to an uncomfortable truth; the fragment does not reveal the claim being rejected.

proposedProfile.register: Neutral; common in everyday, official and psychological discussion.

proposedProfile.meaning_type: Abstract category: a kind or form, here in the expression 'every manner of force'.
proposedProfile.connotation: Neutral as a way of naming kinds; the use of force supplies the negative association.
proposedProfile.tone: Critical here: the sentence describes using every kind of force simply to get one's way.
proposedProfile.register: 'Every manner of' is formal or literary; 'every kind of' is more conversational.
